defect: The fix replaces res->success with res->HasError() to follow a later QueryResult API change.
reason: QueryResult still had a success member when this change was written, so the code was correct against its base; the compile error came from the later interface change.

defect: The new filesystem-wide file_handle_cache is read and written without any lock from concurrently opened handles and its entries never expire, so cached length/last_modified go stale and the map is raced.
reason: The fix adds a mutex around cache lookup and insert plus a max-age check, repairing exactly the cache this change introduced.

defect: For TINYINT/SMALLINT groups without statistics the fallback stats are built as [MinimumValue, MinimumValue] instead of [MinimumValue, MaximumValue], so the perfect hash table is sized for a single value.
reason: The fix changes the second argument to MaximumValue (and restructures the bit computation) in lines this change added.

defect: The fix changes rel->context.GetContext() to rel->context->GetContext() after Relation::context became a shared_ptr.
reason: At this change's base Relation::context was a ClientContextWrapper value, so the line was correct; it broke only when merged with the concurrent change that made context a shared_ptr.

defect: The fix rejects parameter_number 0 and stops adding 1 to the parameter identifier in SQLDescribeParam.
reason: The parameter_number < 0 check was moved unchanged from the old lambda and the to_string(parameter_number + 1) identifier came from the named-parameters merge, not from this lambda removal.

defect: The fix stops serializing the bound constraints/defaults/query and instead re-binds the CreateInfo on deserialization.
reason: Deserializing only these lists without binding state was already incomplete before this change, which only fixed the schema lookup; the fix redesigns the approach.

defect: ConvertVariantToValue indexes the blob data with value_data[row] instead of value_data[value.sel->get_index(row)], reading the wrong row for non-flat inputs.
reason: The fix adds the missing selection-vector lookup in a line this change added; every other access in the same function already uses sel.

defect: The fix moves DistinctAggregateData::Initialize and AnyDistinct out of the header into the .cpp and drops the redundant struct keyword.
reason: The fix in this file is a code move with identical logic, so it repairs no defect here (the out-of-range aggr_idx indexing is still present after it).

defect: With force_no_cross_product set, a disconnected join graph (a legitimate cross product) throws InternalException('HyperGraph isn't connected') instead of keeping the original plan.
reason: The fuzzer-found fix replaces exactly the throw this change added with returning the unchanged plan.

defect: The fix removes a duplicate InstanceMethod('interrupt') that tripped a node debug assertion, and drops the unused Database::constructor reference.
reason: The duplicate 'interrupt' registration was added by the later commit 4cee6fb; the static constructor this change added is harmless and kept for Connection and Statement.

defect: In this header the fix only removes the unused static Database::constructor declaration.
reason: That declaration was only moved by this change and is not a defect; the assertion the fix targets comes from the duplicate 'interrupt' method in database.cpp, not from lines of this file.

defect: The fix clamps the estimated remaining seconds before an int32_t conversion added later.
reason: This change only renamed the filter methods; the (int32_t) conversion of a possibly huge double did not exist in its lines.

defect: In the no-NULL branch of RadixScatterListVector the DESC inversion starts at key_location_start + 1, skipping the list-empty marker byte because it wrongly assumes a validity byte exists.
reason: The fix makes the no-NULL DESC loop start at key_location_start, which is what the old code inverted before this change.

defect: Value::MAP(child_type, values) pushes children[0] into map_values, so every map value becomes a copy of its key.
reason: The fix changes children[0] to children[1] in a line this change added.

defect: The fix adds a NOLINT comment to allow the implicit QueryContext(optional_ptr) constructor for clang-tidy.
reason: This is a tooling/style change, not a repair of a runtime or compile defect.

defect: The fix replaces a C-style cast to LogicalDependentJoin with root->Cast<LogicalDependentJoin>() for clang-tidy.
reason: The cast is checked by the type test right before it, so the change is style only.

defect: MergeValidityRange stops only when tuples[i] > start + count, so an update at exactly start + count is written one past the requested range.
reason: The fix changes > to >= in the range check this change added.

defect: The new test has REQUIRE(1==0) without a semicolon, which does not compile, and would also always fail.
reason: The 'Fixes for GCC' commit adds the semicolon and changes the condition in the line this change added.

defect: The fix ('Wrong file') restores the shellcpp branch's version of shell.cpp after a merge of main took the wrong file.
reason: It corrects a merge resolution on another branch and does not repair a defect in this change's .dump code.

defect: For NULL constants in OR filters, IS DISTINCT FROM NULL is mapped to IsNullFilter and IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL to IsNotNullFilter (inverted), and = NULL / <> NULL push null filters although they never match.
reason: The fix swaps the two filters and stops pushing filters for EQUAL/NOTEQUAL, in the switch this change added.

defect: The fix changes duckdb_create_time_tz to return the new duckdb_time_tz struct and documents it.
reason: The uint64_t return type matched the API at this change's base; the struct type was introduced by the following commit 62902a1, and the fix aligns the function with it.

defect: For constant input the result Reference()s the bind data's shared keys vector and is retyped as CONSTANT, so later operations on the result (e.g. Flatten moving the auxiliary list child out of the shared buffer) corrupt the bind data used by later calls.
reason: The fix, which names a bug with constant input, replaces that path with ConstantVector::Reference into the result's own buffer (and Slice for the dictionary path).

defect: The fix returns ALREADY_EXISTS for ATTACH IF NOT EXISTS of an already attached read-only database instead of increasing its reference count.
reason: The read-only reference-counting branch it corrects was added later by 4b21904; this change only added the is_attached detach state.

defect: The fix re-enables two slow tests after issue #7406 was fixed.
reason: Disabling and re-enabling tests is a test change, not a defect repair.

defect: ExecuteTernaryInternal and ExecuteQuaternaryInternal treat the input as constant when only a and b are constant, so non-constant c/d inputs are evaluated for one row and the result is wrongly marked constant.
reason: The fix adds the c and d constant checks to the conditions this change added.

defect: The fix flips the debug assertion from Category() != STANDARD to == STANDARD.
reason: The inverted comparison came from the earlier commit 10ee4c77; this change only inlined the variable to silence an unused-variable warning.

defect: In this file the 'Fixing deadlock' commit only rewraps the long if condition.
reason: The change to this file is formatting only and repairs nothing in the lines this change added.

defect: The fix makes the expected-error regex check pass only when the regex actually matches, removing a false positive for non-regex expected errors.
reason: The regex_matches == want_match logic was introduced earlier by 1d610dc and only moved into CompareValues by this change.

defect: The fix uses column distinct counts only for catalog tables, because parquet and other scans report distinct count 0.
reason: This new file moved ExtractGetStats verbatim from statistics_extractor.cpp, where the same unconditional use of the statistics' distinct count already existed.

defect: The change uses ExpressionIterator::EnumerateChildren without including duckdb/planner/expression_iterator.hpp, which none of its headers pull in, so the file fails to compile in non-unity builds.
reason: The 'fix headers' commit adds the missing expression_iterator.hpp include (and normalizes the angle-bracket include) for code this change added.

defect: The fix stops calling move(event) inside the ScheduleTasks loop, which left every task after the first with a null event.
reason: This change only reformatted that line; the move(event) inside the loop was already there before.

defect: The fix restores the plan-serialization tests on the new BinarySerializer API.
reason: This change deliberately disabled the tests and the fix re-enables them with a new API, a test and feature change.

defect: TransformCatalogReservedSchemaTable builds TableDescription(catalog, catalog, table_name), dropping the parsed schema.
reason: The fix passes schema as the second argument in the line this change added.

defect: The fix exits ParseExtensionMetaData early on an invalid magic value (and skips the signature check) so the expected error message appears, and sorts includes.
reason: The metadata parsing it guards came from earlier commits; this change's semver parsing and GetAPI lines are not touched beyond the include order.

defect: The fix makes AreCommentsAcceptable accept a user-set comment character (issue #14648) and marks the default candidate vectors const.
reason: The real fix is in AreCommentsAcceptable, which this change did not touch; the const additions on its lines are style.

defect: TryDequeueWithoutConcurrentPurge loads purge_active as the CAS expected value, so the CAS succeeds even while a purge is active and then clears the purging thread's flag.
reason: The fix makes the CAS expect false and retry, so it waits until no purge is active, in the function this change added.

defect: The new even() checks parity with ceiled_value / 2 * 2 on floating-point values (always equal, so even(2.5) returns 3) and rounds negative values toward zero instead of away from zero.
reason: The fix rewrites the EvenOperator added by this change to use an integer parity check and symmetric rounding for negatives.

defect: The fix changes the expected uri_encode outputs in Verify() from '+' to '%20' for spaces.
reason: The '+' expectations were already wrong in the previous commit 6c159ee; this change only swapped which call expects an encoded slash.

defect: The fix changes the query_progress docstring wording to match the generated stub file.
reason: This is a documentation/generated-file consistency change, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix plans children that carry a bound_node, uses child.GetTypes() and null-checks child.binder.
reason: bound_node, GetTypes and binder-less children were introduced by the following WIP commit a310228; the fix adapts plan_setop to that redesign.
